source.note: TCDB is the checklist authority. Distribution and pack configuration were cross-checked against BaseballCardPedia. Promotional Samples, the Promotional Samples Panel, and the Alex Rodriguez store-display promo are intentionally excluded. The standalone Andruw Jones autograph and three specialty insert families without a published standard-pack insertion ratio are retained as catalog sets with null odds so they remain non-pullable until reviewed.

decisions.packChannelAbstraction: VCS uses one universal 10-card Hobby-size pack and combines Series One and Series Two into one equally weighted 553-card base pool. Series-exclusive insertion ratios are translated into the merged pool using checklist share: Series One 300/553 and Series Two 253/553. Hobby-only and Retail-only pack inserts remain available in the universal VCS pack; published denominators are rounded to the nearest integer after series weighting.
decisions.goldMedallionRepresentation: One logical Gold Medallion parallel is derived for each of the 553 base cards. TCDB currently reports 554 Gold Medallion records while its own notes define #G1-G553; VCS intentionally normalizes this to the 553-card base numbering rather than creating a duplicate logical card.
decisions.platinumMedallionRepresentation: One logical Platinum Medallion parallel is derived for each of the 553 base cards. Series One cards are PR200-or-less and Series Two cards are PR150-or-less; print-run metadata is retained in the source checklist rather than Player.
decisions.specialtyCatalogSets: Emerald Autographstix Redemptions, Hideki Irabu Commemorative Edition, Hideki Irabu Commemorative Edition 5x7, and the standalone Andruw Jones autograph are retained with null pack odds because a standard-pack denominator is not published. The 5x7 set is a box insert, not a normal pack pull.
decisions.packSimulationLimitation: The physical product guaranteed a Gold Medallion plus another insert in each pack. The current VCS engine rolls non-base Product Sets independently, so rare multi-hit packs can occur. Odds are preserved as closely as the existing integer-denominator model allows; no pack-engine rewrite is included in this bundle.
